statement: Modern refinement of C241: if f:A→B has a fully faithful right adjoint, then for every prederivatorD, f*:D(B)→D(A) is fully faithful. More generally require f to be a homotopical epimorphism to obtain this for every derivator.

his_statement: Not an additional authorial assertion. This audit tests the unrestricted reading of the exact lattice passages already quoted in SA27-C442–SA27-C445.
statement: Modern audit counterexample to the unrestricted-localizer reading of the lattice: let W₀ detect bijections on π₀, B=BC₂, E the chaotic groupoid on {0,1}, and p:E→B send the unique arrow i→j to j−i mod 2. Then p is a discrete bifibration and hence W₀-proper and W₀-smooth. The W₀-map q:*→B pulls back to the discrete two-object groupoid→E, which is not W₀. Thus p is not strong Serre; in fact p itself lies in W₀ and its comma transports are equivalences, so the unrestricted As=W∩WSC style identities also fail.
computation: Root ../../code/groupoid_pi0.py and ../../outputs/groupoid_pi0.json verify lift uniqueness, pullback arrow labels and component counts 2→1.
fate: SGA1 VI supplies the unique-lift definition, and Maltsiniotis 2005 Example 3.2.2 shows every pre(co)fibration is proper/smooth. The finite computation and analytic morphism check in this run verify every counterexample hypothesis. It is not attributed to an external publication or to Grothendieck.
present_status: As of 2026-11-19: A valid counterexample for the arbitrary-localizer interpretation, even with W⊆W₀. It does not refute the W∞ lattice. See C442–C445 for the original authorial assertions and proof_checks.md §14 for the complete argument.
